findings.mechanism: adoptLegs overwrote terminal OCO child with delayed nonterminal status at unchanged cumulative fill; protectionSnapshot could report canceled protection as covered.
findings.remediation: Preserve terminal state for unchanged fills; retain larger cumulative fills for reconciliation.
findings.tests: Native leg unit cases and full reconcile case.

findings.mechanism: manage skipped MARKET_CLOSED campaigns before managePosition could cancel a partially filled pending entry.
findings.remediation: Permit only pending-entry management branch for a fresh, owned MARKET_CLOSED evaluation; branch cancels then returns before every sell/protection path.
findings.tests: Closed-session cancellation, bounded retry, reopen protection, late fill and stale/uncertain ownership rejection.

limitations: All broker events are synthetic in-memory fixtures; no market/account or real latency evidence.
Cancel request does not establish cancellation; syncAt invalidated and ownership must be reconciled.
